ios.desc:
AlmostZero is a personal finance app that helps you manage debt, track spending, and reach your savings goals. Credit cards, student loans, mortgages, auto loans — bring all your debts together in one app and get a clear picture of your financial situation.

Struggling to plan repayments, spending more than you'd like, or finding it hard to save consistently? AlmostZero is designed to help you organize your money and stay on track without the stress. With visual progress indicators and practical repayment strategies, you can see exactly where you stand and how to move forward.

【Key Features】

▸ Debt & Loan Management
Track credit cards, personal loans, mortgages, auto loans, and student loans all in one place. The app automatically calculates accrued interest, remaining term, and estimated payoff date, so you can see the status of every debt at a glance.

Repayment frequency is fully customizable — weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, and more, matched to your income cycle. Clear progress charts show you how far you've come and help you stay motivated.

Two proven repayment strategies are supported: the snowball method (pay off the smallest debts first) and the avalanche method (pay off the highest-interest debts first). Choose the strategy that fits your situation best.

▸ Expense Tracking
Log your daily expenses and they're automatically organized by category. View spending by merchant or category to understand exactly where your money is going.

Analyze spending trends by day, week, month, or year to identify your habits. Set a budget and receive a notification when you're approaching your limit.

▸ Savings Goals
Create multiple savings goals with individual target amounts and deadlines. The app automatically calculates the savings pace you need and displays your progress clearly. A progress bar helps you stay on track.

▸ Link to Assets
Connect your debts to assets like property or vehicles. By viewing debts and assets together, you get a more complete picture of your overall financial position.

▸ Tag Organization
Use custom tags to organize your debts and expenses flexibly. View totals and statistics by tag to analyze your finances from different angles.

▸ Multiple Currencies
All major world currencies are supported. Switch your display currency with a single tap — convenient for use abroad or managing finances across multiple currencies.

quotes.text:
Hi Hacker News!

My first iphone app is a simple personal finance utility. The interface lets you plug in the debts and savings goals you have, and the UI displays a dashboard to monitor those debts and savings.

Screenshots & UI: https://www.reddit.com/r/iOSProgramming/s/JfJjruelgR

App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/downpay-track-debt-savings/id6474574024

My goal was to make the app easy to use but at the same time detailed and customizable. You can achieve the same results with a spreadsheet but I wanted to build something fun to use right from your phone.

There’s no backend, no user auth, or any dependencies on a server. This is purely a utility and all data is 100% private :) It is only saved locally on device and in iCloud.

User privacy and convenience is my #1 priority with this app. No data is collected, not even analytics :o  If you run into a bug or crash, please submit a bug :)

Features:
1. Debt Manager:
   - Manage 14 types of debt in one place, including credit cards, student loans, auto loans, mortgages and more.
   - Detailed progress reports, and plan repayment with a user-friendly UI.

2. Savings Manager:
   - Set and track savings goals for major purchases such as a downpayment on a house, emergency fund, wedding, home renovation, grad school, or a new car, and much more 
   - Each savings can have multiple buckets the goal pulls from(such as savings account, gifts from family or brokerage + physical cash etc) and see how close you are to …
